function.name: process_transaction
function.description: Executes a financial transaction between two accounts, applying transaction fees, and updating account balances accordingly. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

source_account.description: The unique identifier of the account from which funds are being transferred.

destination_account.description: The unique identifier of the account to which funds are being transferred.

amount.description: The amount of money to be transferred in dollars. This is a float type value.

currency.description: The currency in which the transaction will be processed.

transaction_fee.description: The transaction fee in dollars that will be applied. If not specified, a default fee is applied based on the amount. This is a float type value.

apply_fee_to_recipient.description: Indicates whether the transaction fee should be deducted from the recipient's amount instead of the sender's.

transaction_date.description: The date when the transaction is to be executed, in the format 'MM/DD/YYYY'. If not specified, the transaction will be executed immediately.

notification_preference.description: The preferred method of notification for transaction completion.
